newsitem.title: UK: Medeva to update on Hepagene on Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: Medeva to update on Hepagene on Jan 23.

text.p: British pharmaceutical company Medeva Plc said on Friday it would announce the results next Thursday of clinical trials of its hepatitis B product Hepagene.
In a statement, Medeva said that on the same day it would also present analysts with a review of the test results.

The company said last autumn that it expected to publish the results this month of phase III trials of the vaccine and of pre-clinical trials to evaluate Hepagene's potential in treating chronic sufferers of the disease, which affects about 300 million people worldwide.
